author: Whatfinger
title: King praises Trump's 'commitment' to ending wars - as Trump hails 'priceless' UK-US bond - World News
text:
The King and Donald Trump have hailed the "special relationship" between the UK and the US in speeches during a state banquet at Windsor Castle.
It was a day full of pomp and pageantry – from the carriage procession which carried Mr Trump, first lady Melania Trump, and the King and Queen to Windsor Castle, to the lavish banquet held in the president’s honour.
Sky’s US correspondent Mark Stone reports on the events of the first day of Mr Trump’s unprecedented second UK state visit, and reflects on its political and diplomatic significance.
Read more: https://trib.al/CFQDtpA
